nodes.description: Public uint8 tracking the contract stage (1=deposits, 2=closed, 3=payout/withdrawals).
Address of the contract creator; used in the onlyOwner access control check.
Array of contribution caps in wei; index 0 is the overall pool cap.
Owner fee percentage, expressed with 20 decimals of precision.
Address that the pooled ETH is finally sent to in submitPool().
Constant minimum contribution amount (0.1 ETH).
Constant maximum gas price allowed for deposits in stage 1.
External WhiteList contract used to query member levels.
Flag toggling whether the external whitelist logic is enforced.
Timestamp at which pending contribution caps become active.
Pending contribution caps to be applied after nextCapTime.
Block number of the last receiverAddress change; enforces 6000 block delay.
ETH balance snapshot at submitPool(); used for refund/token percentages.
Array of ETH amounts to be proportionally refunded in stage 3.
Default ERC20 token used for token withdrawals.
Mapping of address to Contributor struct (authorized, balance, cap, refunds, tokens).
Mapping of token address to TokenAllocation struct (token, pct array, remaining).
Reentrancy guard flag used by the noReentrancy modifier.
Internal pure helper converting a ratio to a 20-decimal percentage.
Internal pure helper applying a 20-decimal percentage to an amount.
Constructor; sets owner, receiver, caps, fee and whitelists the owner.
Payable fallback routing incoming ETH to _ethDeposit or _ethRefund.
Internal handler for stage-1 ETH deposits; adds msg.value to caller balance.
Internal handler for stage-3 ETH refunds received from owner/receiver.
Public withdrawal of ETH (stage <3) or ETH/tokens (stage 3) for msg.sender.
Owner-only forced withdrawal on behalf of a contributor in stage 3.
Internal stage-3 payout logic computing ETH refunds and token amounts.
Owner-only addition of a single address to the whitelist with a cap.
Owner-only batch whitelisting of multiple addresses.
Owner-only removal of an address from the whitelist, refunding its balance.
Owner-only modification of a contributor cap, refunding any excess.
Owner-only modification of a contribution level cap.
Owner-only modification of all level caps, optionally delayed via timestamp.
Owner-only modification of the overall pool cap (contributionCaps[0]).
Owner-only toggle of the external whitelist enforcement flag.
Internal cap lookup for an address, applying pending cap changes on timestamp.
Internal query of the external WhiteList contract to auto-authorize an address.
View returning the pool cap, balance and remaining amount.
View returning a contributor's balance, cap and remaining allowance.
View returning claimable token amount for a contributor and token.
Owner-only transition from stage 1 to stage 2.
Owner-only transition from stage 2 back to stage 1.
Owner-only setting of the receiver address with a block-based delay.
Owner-only noReentrancy function sending pooled ETH to receiver and moving to stage 3.
Owner-only noReentrancy function computing token distribution percentages.
ERC223 token fallback emitting an event on token receipt.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, whitelist lookups and transfers.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for delayed cap activation checks.
Low-level receiverAddress.call.value(...).gas(...) in submitPool; arbitrary external call.
msg.sender.transfer(amountToTransfer) during stage <3 withdrawal.
receiver.transfer(ethAmount) inside _withdraw.
addr.transfer(amountToTransfer) refund inside revoke.
addr.transfer(excess) refund inside modifyIndividualCap.
d.token.transfer(receiver,tokenAmount) token payout inside _withdraw.
d.token.transfer(owner, fee) fee payout inside enableTokenWithdrawals.
External call to whitelistContract.checkMemberLevel(addr); return value semi-trusted.
Inline assembly extcodesize check used to reject contracts in authorize.
SafeMath add used for the contributor balance update in _ethDeposit.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to owner in the onlyOwner modifier, gating privileged functions.
msg.sender is used as the key into the whitelist mapping.
msg.sender determines the contributor struct updated in _ethDeposit.
msg.sender must equal owner or receiverAddress in _ethRefund.
msg.sender selects the contributor balance refunded in withdraw.
msg.sender (via receiver) drives token and ETH payouts in _withdraw.
submitPool is restricted to owner, checked against msg.sender.
block.timestamp is compared to nextCapTime to activate pending caps.
block.timestamp is used to validate the delayed cap change time parameter.
_checkCap activates pending caps when block.timestamp exceeds nextCapTime.
checkContributorBalance branches on block.timestamp versus nextCapTime.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Constructor initializes contributionCaps from capAmounts.
Constructor sets feePct via _toPct(fee,100).
Constructor sets receiverAddress from receiverAddr.
Constructor whitelists the contract owner.
Constructor calls _toPct to compute the fee percentage.
_withdraw calls _toPct to derive the contributor refund percentage.
enableTokenWithdrawals calls _toPct to compute the token distribution pct.
_withdraw calls _applyPct to compute ETH refund and token amounts.
checkAvailableTokens calls _applyPct to compute claimable tokens.
enableTokenWithdrawals calls _applyPct to compute the owner fee.
Fallback routes to _ethDeposit when contractStage == 1.
Fallback routes to _ethRefund when contractStage == 3.
_ethDeposit asserts the contract is in stage 1.
_ethDeposit requires tx.gasprice <= maxGasPrice.
_ethDeposit checks the contract balance against contributionCaps[0].
_ethDeposit calls _checkCap to enforce the contributor cap.
_ethDeposit performs SafeMath add on contributor balances.
_ethRefund asserts the contract is in stage 3.
_ethRefund pushes the received ETH amount into ethRefundAmount.
withdraw reads the caller's Contributor entry from whitelist.
withdraw performs msg.sender.transfer for stage <3 withdrawals.
withdraw delegates to _withdraw during stage 3.
withdrawFor delegates the payout to _withdraw.
_withdraw uses finalBalance to compute the ETH refund percentage.
_withdraw iterates ethRefundAmount to compute refunds.
_withdraw reads the TokenAllocation from distributionMap.
_withdraw falls back to activeToken when tokenAddr is zero.
_withdraw performs receiver.transfer(ethAmount), an external ETH call.
_withdraw performs d.token.transfer(receiver,tokenAmount), an external token call.
authorize requires the contract to be in stage 1.
authorize writes cap and authorized into the whitelist mapping.
authorize validates cap against contributionCaps bounds.
authorize calls _checkWhitelistContract before whitelisting.
authorize uses inline assembly extcodesize to reject contracts.
authorizeMany loops and calls authorize for each address.
authorizeMany validates cap against contributionCaps bounds.
revoke requires the contract stage to be less than 3.
revoke clears authorization and balance in the whitelist mapping.
revoke queries the external whitelist contract member level.
revoke performs addr.transfer(amountToTransfer), an external ETH call.
modifyIndividualCap requires the contract stage to be less than 3.
modifyIndividualCap updates the contributor cap and balance.
modifyIndividualCap validates cap against contributionCaps bounds.
modifyIndividualCap calls _checkCap to recompute the allowed amount.
modifyIndividualCap performs addr.transfer(excess), an external ETH call.
modifyLevelCap requires the contract stage to be less than 3.
modifyLevelCap writes the new cap into contributionCaps[level].
modifyLevelCap resets nextCapTime to 0, cancelling delayed changes.
modifyAllLevelCaps calls modifyLevelCap for immediate changes.
modifyAllLevelCaps sets nextCapTime for the delayed cap change.
modifyAllLevelCaps populates nextContributionCaps with pending caps.
modifyMaxContractBalance updates contributionCaps[0] and clamps level caps.
modifyMaxContractBalance resets nextCapTime to 0.
toggleWhitelist writes the whitelistIsActive flag.
_checkCap checks whitelistIsActive before external verification.
_checkCap reads contributionCaps to resolve the effective cap.
_checkCap tests nextCapTime against block.timestamp.
_checkCap applies nextContributionCaps when the delay has elapsed.
_checkCap reads the contributor entry from the whitelist mapping.
_checkCap calls _checkWhitelistContract to verify the address.
_checkWhitelistContract queries whitelistContract.checkMemberLevel.
_checkWhitelistContract updates cap and authorized in the whitelist mapping.
_checkWhitelistContract invokes the external checkMemberLevel call.
checkPoolBalance branches on contractStage.
checkPoolBalance returns contributionCaps[0].
checkContributorBalance branches on contractStage.
checkContributorBalance queries the external whitelist contract.
checkContributorBalance reads the contributor entry from whitelist.
checkContributorBalance reads contributionCaps for the cap lookup.
checkContributorBalance reads nextContributionCaps for delayed caps.
checkAvailableTokens reads the contributor entry from whitelist.
checkAvailableTokens reads the TokenAllocation from distributionMap.
closeContributions sets contractStage to 2.
reopenContributions sets contractStage back to 1.
setReceiverAddress requires contractStage < 3.
setReceiverAddress writes the new receiverAddress.
setReceiverAddress records addressChangeBlock to enforce the delay.
submitPool requires contractStage < 3 and sets it to 3.
submitPool pays out to receiverAddress.
submitPool enforces the 6000 block delay via addressChangeBlock.
submitPool snapshots this.balance into finalBalance.
submitPool pushes leftover balance into ethRefundAmount.
submitPool performs a low-level call to receiverAddress with value.
enableTokenWithdrawals requires contractStage == 3.
enableTokenWithdrawals computes the owner fee from feePct.
enableTokenWithdrawals uses finalBalance to compute the pct.
enableTokenWithdrawals sets the activeToken default.
enableTokenWithdrawals writes the TokenAllocation into distributionMap.
enableTokenWithdrawals performs d.token.transfer(owner, fee), an external call.
tokenFallback receives token data from an untrusted external token contract.
The low-level call to receiverAddress can re-enter submitPool before stage is updated.
The low-level call to receiverAddress can re-enter withdraw before state is finalized.
The low-level call can re-enter the payable fallback of this contract.
receiver.transfer can trigger a fallback that re-enters the contract.
The ERC20 transfer may invoke tokenFallback on a malicious token contract.
The fee token transfer may invoke tokenFallback on a malicious token contract.

Shared cap parameter belongs to authorizeMany.

New cap parameter is consumed by modifyIndividualCap.

Cap value parameter is consumed by modifyLevelCap.
Cap array parameter is consumed by modifyAllLevelCaps.
Delay time parameter feeds the timestamp check in modifyAllLevelCaps.
Amount parameter is consumed by modifyMaxContractBalance.
Boolean flag parameter is consumed by toggleWhitelist.
Payout amount parameter drives the external call in submitPool.
Token address parameter is consumed by enableTokenWithdrawals.
Default-token flag parameter is consumed by enableTokenWithdrawals.
ERC223 sender parameter is only used to emit the event in tokenFallback.
ERC223 value parameter is only used to emit the event in tokenFallback.
ERC223 data parameter is unused and belongs to tokenFallback.
Local storage reference only used within _ethDeposit.
Balance accumulator scoped to the deposit logic.
Refund amount local is directly used as the value of the msg.sender transfer.
Computed refund percentage local used only in _withdraw.
Accumulated ETH local is the value passed to receiver.transfer.
Loop index local scoped to the _withdraw loops.
Accumulated token local is the value passed to the ERC20 transfer.
Distribution storage reference local used only in _withdraw.
Local holds the result of the inline assembly extcodesize check.
Balance snapshot local used only in modifyIndividualCap.
Recomputed cap local used only in modifyIndividualCap.
Distribution storage reference local used only in enableTokenWithdrawals.

Return value local of the external checkMemberLevel call.
Contributor storage reference local used only in _checkCap.
